items: Replying to positive reviews makes guests feel appreciated, humanizes your brand, gives you free promotion, and lets you add relevant keywords that help your search visibility.
Thank the guest first, use their name, and mention what they enjoyed so your reply reads as personal instead of a copy-pasted template.
Respond quickly and keep it short, because late or long replies lose their impact with guests and search engines alike.
Use the reply to bring the guest back by suggesting a dish to try next, offering a discount, or inviting them to your loyalty program.
